title: Elucidating the role of KLRD1 in coronary atherosclerosis: harnessing bioinformatics and machine learning to advance understanding.
summary: LASSO and SVM-RFE selected candidate genes for coronary atherosclerosis; KLRD1 was among 23 hub genes and had reported AUC 0.741 in the separate GSE9820 dataset. This supports a computational candidate association, not causal biology or prospective clinical utility.
ai_technology: LASSO and SVM-RFE selected candidate genes from expression data; KLRD1 was assessed in a separate expression dataset.
organization: State Key Laboratory for Innovation and Transformation of Luobing Theory; Key Laboratory of Cardiovascular Remodeling and Function Research of MOE, NHC, CAMS and Shandong Province; Department of Cardiology, Qilu Hospital of Shandong University, Jinan, China; Department of Cardiology, Qilu Hospital (Qingdao), Cheeloo College of Medicine, Shandong University, China; Department of Cardiology, The People’s Hospital of Jimo, Qingdao, China; Dongying People’s Hospital, Shandong, China

evidence.tested: KLRD1 was among 23 selected hub genes, with differential expression and reported AUC 0.741 in the separate GSE9820 validation dataset.
evidence.unknown: The paper reports expression/ROC validation in a separate dataset and functional assays. The evidence supports a candidate association, not causality or prospective clinical utility.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning feature selection nominated KLRD1 among candidate genes and the study reports validation-dataset discrimination.

source_review.scope: Primary full-text Methods and Results in PMC, including validation of hub genes; publication date checked against primary metadata.
